items.title: Early voting surges across Senate battlegrounds
items.feedTitle: Early voting jumps across Senate battlegrounds as millions more Americans vote ahead of Election Day
items.summary: More than 43 million ballots have been cast in early voting ahead of the midterm elections, with particularly sharp increases in competitive Senate races. The surge outpaces early voting in the previous midterm election. Hispanic voters have driven much of the increase, reflecting strong Democratic enthusiasm in key battleground states.

items.title: Nation at political crossroads as Trump era nears end
items.feedTitle: A midterm crossroads for both parties eyeing the beginning of the end of the Trump era
items.summary: Both major parties face fundamental questions about direction and identity as the 2026 midterms approach. The election marks a potential turning point in the Republican and Democratic parties' trajectories as the Trump presidency's influence begins to wane. Win or lose, the results will shape the parties' paths forward.

items.title: Government corruption emerges as top midterm voter concern
items.feedTitle: Government corruption a top issue for US midterm voters, exclusive poll finds
items.summary: An exclusive poll finds that government corruption has become a leading issue for US voters ahead of the midterms, with 76% believing officials prioritize self-enrichment over helping constituents. The issue represents a rare twist for midterm elections, typically dominated by economic concerns.

items.title: ICE officer charged after striking man with car
items.feedTitle: An ICE officer has been charged after striking a man with a car in Houston
items.summary: An ICE officer has been indicted after striking a man with a vehicle in Houston during an incident. A Harris County grand jury brought charges against the officer. The case highlights concerns about law enforcement conduct during immigration enforcement operations.

items.title: Majority of Americans say nation in decline
items.feedTitle: New survey finds more than two-thirds of Americans believe their country is in decline
items.summary: A new survey finds that more than two-thirds of Americans believe their country is in decline. Nearly half report experiencing real pain from rising prices, representing a sharp increase from previous years. The sentiment reflects widespread economic anxiety heading into the midterms.

stlouis.title: St. Louis mayor demands police and board overhaul
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis mayor calls for sweeping changes to police department and state-controlled board
stlouis.summary: St. Louis's mayor has called for sweeping changes to the police department and the state-controlled board overseeing it. The announcement signals dissatisfaction with current governance structures and public safety outcomes in the city.

stlouis.title: St. Louis nearing 700 tornado-related demolitions
stlouis.summary: St. Louis is approaching 700 demolitions of structures damaged in recent tornadoes. The ongoing cleanup and reconstruction effort reflects the scale of damage from the storm events.

stlouis.title: Cheesecake Factory to open at West County mall
stlouis.feedTitle: Cheesecake Factory sets opening date at West County mall
stlouis.summary: The Cheesecake Factory has announced an opening date for a new location at a West County shopping mall. The restaurant chain expansion adds another dining option to the region's retail landscape.

items.title: Spain transport minister refuses to resign after rail disaster
items.feedTitle: Spain’s trust in high-speed rail ‘broken’ after second deadly crash this year, says PM
items.summary: Spain's transport minister Óscar Puente says he will not step down following a high-speed train collision that killed at least 69 people earlier in the week. The refusal comes amid public calls for his resignation and mounting criticism over railway safety. Spain's PM acknowledged that 'trust in high-speed rail has been broken' and vowed investigations.

items.title: Ceasefire allows humanitarian evacuation from Oleshky
items.feedTitle: Ceasefire allows evacuation from devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky
items.summary: A local ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine enabled humanitarian aid to enter the devastated city of Oleshky, with evacuation operations underway. However, several hundred residents chose to remain despite lacking gas, electricity, and running water. The truce marks the most significant pause in fighting in the 4½-year conflict.

items.title: Russia's last major independent newspaper closes
items.feedTitle: Russian society being ‘systematically crushed’ says Novaya Gazeta as newspaper announces closure
items.summary: Novaya Gazeta, one of Russia's last independent media outlets and whose former editor won a Nobel Prize, has announced permanent closure next month. The closure comes after mounting pressure from authorities. The newspaper had been a prominent voice for independent journalism in Russia over three decades.

items.title: Netanyahu alleges Israel's election was stolen
items.feedTitle: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party has claimed foreign interference and alleged that Arab-led parties 'stole' the election after his coalition lost its parliamentary majority. The opposition condemned Netanyahu's delegitimization efforts. Israel faces difficult negotiations as no clear governing majority emerged from the vote.

items.title: Trump warns of 'insane' Iran war plan amid mediation efforts
items.feedTitle: Senators briefed on Trump’s ‘insane’ plan to restart war on Iran
items.summary: A senator briefed on Trump's reported plan to restart war with Iran says it could have 'devastating' consequences, calling it 'insane.' Meanwhile, Qatari mediators have returned to Tehran to push for a US-Iran ceasefire deal. Trump claims the conflict will 'end soon' amid escalating tensions and tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Uttarakhand helicopter crash kills six near Joshimath
items.feedTitle: Uttarakhand chopper crash: All six on board killed, says Chamoli District Magistrate
items.summary: A helicopter carrying pilgrims crashed near Badrinath in Uttarakhand, killing all six on board, including five pilgrims from Karnataka and a pilot from Delhi. The aircraft lost contact amid adverse weather conditions. The government has grounded the entire fleet operated by Trans Bharat Aviation pending investigation.

items.title: Census 2027 door-to-door enumeration begins January 25
items.feedTitle: Census 2027: door-to-door enumeration to start on January 25
items.summary: India's Census 2027 will commence door-to-door enumeration on January 25 with a reference date of March 1. The census will not be held in Manipur, Goa, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu & Kashmir. This marks a significant administrative undertaking for the country.

items.title: Rafale M makes maiden landing on INS Vikrant
items.feedTitle: Rafale M carries out maiden landing, take-off on INS Vikrant | India News
items.summary: A Rafale Marine jet successfully completed its first landing and take-off on INS Vikrant, India's domestically-built aircraft carrier. The milestone represents a significant achievement in integrating French fighter jets with India's naval capabilities and demonstrates carrier operations readiness.

items.title: India cuts US and Russian oil, pivots to UAE supplies
items.feedTitle: India cut U.S. and Russian oil imports in September 2026, pivoting to the UAE as tariffs and sanctions reshaped the market.
items.summary: India reduced oil imports from the US and Russia in September 2026, instead increasing purchases from the UAE. The shift reflects changing tariff regimes, sanctions pressures, and market dynamics. Russia and UAE now account for 60% of India's total oil imports.

items.title: India and Nepal strengthen border security cooperation
items.feedTitle: India and Nepal agree to strengthen border security through sharing, coordination and surveillance
items.summary: India and Nepal have agreed to enhance border security through increased sharing of information, coordination, and surveillance capabilities. The agreement reflects both nations' commitment to maintaining border stability and addressing cross-border security challenges.

immigration.title: Trump administration tightens H-1B visa extension review
immigration.feedTitle: Trump moves to end H-1B visa deference: What it means for Indians stuck in the Green Card backlog
immigration.summary: The Trump administration is moving to end deference to prior H-1B visa approvals, proposed, not final—requiring closer scrutiny of extension requests. The change will affect thousands of Indian workers on H-1B visas seeking to renew or extend their status. This regulatory shift could complicate the visa process for employment-based immigrants.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows EB-3 progress for India
immigration.feedTitle: Nov Visa Bulletin: Green card dates advance for Indian family applicants
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin shows modest advances in employment-based green card dates, with EB-3 moving forward for Indian applicants while EB-2 remains unchanged—finalized and in effect. Family-sponsored visas advanced by one year. The bulletin reflects the ongoing bottleneck for Indian EB-2 applicants, whose priority dates remain stuck in 2013.

immigration.title: PERM modernization rule clears OMB review
immigration.feedTitle: PERM Modernization Rule Clears OMB Review: What Employers Should Know
immigration.summary: A proposed rule modernizing the PERM labor certification process has cleared Office of Management and Budget review, not yet final. The changes aim to update green card sponsorship requirements and streamline employment-based immigration. The rule could significantly affect the green card pathway for skilled workers.

items.title: Nasdaq hits three-month low on AI capex concerns
items.feedTitle: Nasdaq set for sharp drop as Amazon, Intel amplify AI spending worries
items.summary: The Nasdaq dropped over 2% to near its lowest level in three months as Amazon and Intel's earnings reports highlighted massive AI infrastructure spending with slowing core growth. Tech giants' multi-billion-dollar data center investments spooked investors about returns on AI capex. The selloff wiped out nearly $600 billion in tech market value.

items.title: North Korea blamed for record $6.3B Binance crypto hack
items.feedTitle: North Korea is likely culprit behind $6.3bn crypto hack, ‘largest heist in history’
items.summary: A North Korean-based hacking group is believed responsible for a $6.3 billion theft from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, likely the largest heist in history. Binance says it will cover customer losses and has frozen about $3 billion of affected assets. Two blockchain intelligence firms linked the attack to TraderTraitor, a known North Korean unit.

items.title: Alphabet loses record $475 billion in market value
items.feedTitle: Alphabet loses $475 billion in market value, the biggest drop in its history
items.summary: Google's parent company Alphabet shed a record $475 billion in market capitalization in a single day after revealing its AI search summaries are hurting ad revenue. The stock plunge left the trading metric at levels unseen in over a decade. The massive selloff reflects investor concerns about AI's impact on Google's core advertising business.

items.title: Indian shares snap two-month losing streak
items.feedTitle: Sensex Gains 308 Points, Nifty Reclaims 23,000 as IT and Pharma Stocks Lead Recovery
items.summary: Sensex gained 308 points and Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark as IT and pharma stocks led recovery, ending October on a positive note. Indian shares snapped a two-month losing streak with foreign buying fueling the rebound. However, midcap and smallcap stocks underperformed the index gains.

items.title: Oil majors report blowout profits amid Iran war
items.feedTitle: ExxonMobil and Chevron report blowout profits as Trump touts benefits of high oil prices
items.summary: ExxonMobil and Chevron reported record profits as refining margins surged during the Iran conflict, with US oil industry earning over $130 billion in profit during the war. Trump touted the benefits of high oil prices as oil remained above $100 per barrel. The energy sector's strong performance contrasts with broader market turmoil.

finance.note: Oil rose above $115 on US-Iran strike fears and tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, while US tech stocks plummeted over 2% on Amazon and Intel's AI capex warnings, erasing nearly $600 billion in market value. Indian stocks snapped a losing streak with Nifty reclaiming 23,000, though midcaps underperformed. Watch: Fed's next move on rates, Trump's Iran military decisions, and whether big tech earnings stabilize markets.

cards.title: Constraint breeds invention
cards.insight: Creative breakthroughs often emerge not from unlimited resources but from working within tight boundaries—whether time, budget, or tools. When everything is available, the mind defaults to obvious choices. Constraints force lateral thinking and novel combinations of existing elements.
cards.takeaway: In your next project, deliberately impose a limitation (time, materials, budget) and treat problem-solving within that box as the real creative challenge.

cards.title: Cross-pollination over expertise
cards.insight: The most innovative solutions come from combining ideas from different domains rather than deepening expertise within a single field. A musician might solve a design problem using composition principles; an engineer might approach storytelling with systems thinking. Diversity of perspective matters more than depth alone.
cards.takeaway: Actively seek collaborators from unrelated fields and ask them how they'd approach your problem using their domain's logic.

cards.title: Failure as data collection
cards.insight: Failed experiments aren't setbacks—they're rapid feedback loops. Every unsuccessful attempt eliminates a hypothesis and clarifies the search space. The creative process is less about having the right idea upfront and more about efficiently iterating through wrong ones.
cards.takeaway: Reframe 'failure' as 'iteration' and measure progress by how many hypotheses you've tested, not by how many worked on first try.

cards.title: Rest enables recombination
cards.insight: Creativity isn't a continuous output; it requires incubation. When you step away from a problem, your subconscious continues pattern-matching across stored memories and concepts. The 'aha moment' often arrives after rest, not during focused effort.
cards.takeaway: Build deliberate breaks into creative work—walk, sleep, or work on something unrelated—then return with fresh perspective.

ai.title: Anthropic IPO filing highlights AI risks to investors
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic’s IPO filing spends 69,800 words on AI’s risks to investors and says little about the risks to the rest of us
ai.summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus devotes 69,800 words to potential risks to investors but says little about risks to the broader public from AI systems. The filing reveals the company spent substantially on safety issues while warning about diseconomies of scale in AI training. As Anthropic prepares to go public, scrutiny mounts over AI governance and safety.

ai.title: Anthropic staff warn AI could pose existential risk
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic staff warn AI could kill us all as its safety rules weaken
ai.summary: Anthropic employees have warned that AI could potentially kill humanity, while noting the company's safety rules are weakening as it moves toward profitability and IPO. The internal concerns raise questions about the balance between commercial pressures and AI safety priorities at major labs.

ai.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT in $15B deal
ai.summary: Thrive Holdings, backed by OpenAI, is acquiring home security company ADT in a $15.3 billion transaction with plans to integrate AI into the business. The deal signals OpenAI's push into smart home and security markets alongside its core AI technology business.

ai.title: Ex-Palantir executives launch Dream AI for construction
ai.feedTitle: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
ai.summary: Former Palantir executives have launched Dream, a startup funded with $17 million from Andreessen Horowitz to build AI world models for construction. Dream's system is trained on over 100 million square feet of building data from US permit archives and is grounded in real physics and construction standards.

ai.title: Microsoft discloses Azure revenue at $33.2 billion
ai.feedTitle: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
ai.summary: Microsoft revealed Azure's quarterly revenue for the first time at $33.2 billion, demonstrating how close the cloud service is getting to rivaling AWS. The disclosure marks a milestone in transparency about Microsoft's cloud business and its position in the AI infrastructure market.
